question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Final query: Get names of players who scored >= 100 runs while playing for the losing team
WITH match_info AS (
    SELECT match_id, 
           CASE WHEN team_1 != match_winner THEN team_1 ELSE team_2 END AS losing_team_id
    FROM match
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
player_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.match_id, bbb.striker AS player_id, 
           SUM(bbs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
           mi.losing_team_id
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
      ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
      AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
      AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
      AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN match_info mi ON bbb.match_id = mi.match_id
    WHERE bbb.team_batting = mi.losing_team_id
    GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, mi.losing_team_id
    HAVING SUM(bbs.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player p ON pr.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_name
